description:
🏡 𝟑𝟎 𝐝𝐚𝐲𝐬. That’s all you’ve got.
If you want your home 𝐒𝐎𝐋𝐃 fast, here’s what I’d prioritize. ⏳

After selling 𝐡𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐡𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐬 𝐂𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐓𝐞𝐱𝐚𝐬, I’ve learned what actually gets homes sold — and what’s just a 𝐰𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐞𝐲. 💸

Here’s the 𝟑𝟎-day plan I’d follow 👇

✨ WEEK 1: Clean + Declutter

🧼 Deep clean everything
77% of buyers want a move-in ready home.

📦 Declutter aggressively
Remove at least 50% of your stuff.

🔧 Fix small repairs
Little issues make buyers worry about bigger ones.

💰 WEEK 2: Quick High-ROI Updates

🎨 Fresh neutral paint
💡 Update light fixtures & hardware
🧽 Clean or replace carpets

Small updates = big impact.

🌿 WEEK 3: Curb Appeal

💦 Power wash driveway & siding
🌱 Fresh mulch + trimmed landscaping
🚪 Upgrade or paint the front door

First impressions matter.

📸 WEEK 4: Stage + Photos

🛋 Professional staging
📷 Professional photography

📊 96% of buyers start their search online.

🚫 Skip major renovations.

If it can’t be finished in 30 days, it’s not worth starting before listing.

🏡 Thinking about selling in Central Texas?
📲 Send me a message and let’s talk strategy.

The Obvious Choice in CTX Sujin Park Henson, TX Lic REALTOR®️, StarPointe Realty
